_source: CORE ELA Pacing Guide 7th Grade (Beyond the Page), and Visions Supplemental Lessons for Moving Beyond the Page 7th, uploaded by Loren 8/28/26. Reused the exact text/url/code fields from semester-plan-generator_btp_g7_ela_pacing.json (the stored per-LP pacing); only added which week each activity's guide table names it, from the guide's own per-week 'Visions Standards Gap Activities' row (one guide occurrence has a typo, 'Gaps Activtiy' instead of 'Gaps Activities' for W.7.2.a-f - cosmetic only, still matched by its bookmark id). All 14 gap activities land within their stored LP's week window, and no Science/HSS-coded activities or stray codes without a matching link were found in this guide's ELA gap rows. NO CURSIVE ENTRY: unlike Grades 1, 4, 5, and 6, this file has no top-level 'cursive' key. The guide's own course-overview paragraph mentions 'Printing/Cursive' only as a generic blurb, with no dedicated weekly assignment link anywhere in the 36-week table, and the stored semester-plan-generator_btp_g7_ela_pacing.json has zero mentions of 'Cursive Writing Assignment' across all 10 LPs (confirmed by grep) - unlike G5/G6's stored data, which mentions it in every LP. This means Grade 7 genuinely doesn't carry a cursive component, so none was invented. This is a real gap against the documented schema (`kind: btp_ela` weeks require a top-level 'cursive' key, and week_shift.py's btp_ela_content() unconditionally reads week_tags['cursive']), and against web/engine.js's own btpElaShiftedContent(), which the how-to doc says always emits cursive at the end of every LP. Flag for Claude Code: either the engine needs a null-check for grades without cursive before this file is spliced into web_data.json, or confirm independently that Grade 7 really has no cursive assignment before wiring it in.
